recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core. Future DeviceUsage indication/reason changes should be made in HL7/oo-incubator unless the resource is reintroduced into the active FHIR-core build.
issue_request: FHIR-12799 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core DeviceUseStatement after DSTU2. It requested references, such as Condition, to explain the medical reason or indication for using a device; the resolution called for workflow event-pattern alignment and partOf or an extension to meet the use.
initial_application: Historical GF#12799/GF#12800/GF#10299 commits added DeviceUseStatement.reasonCode and DeviceUseStatement.reasonReference, mapped reasonReference to Event.reasonReference, and allowed Condition, Observation, DiagnosticReport, and DocumentReference as referenced justifications.
additional_context: FHIR-31478 renamed DeviceUseStatement to DeviceUsage. The current DeviceUsage source lineage represents the old reasonReference capability as DeviceUsage.reason, a CodeableReference including Condition. FHIR-51713 later added DeviceUsage.partOf. A November 2025 OO-resource cleanup removed DeviceUsage from the active core resource list and current core pages now link DeviceUsage to HL7/oo-incubator, where the DeviceUsage definition includes the same Condition-capable reason element.
reconciliation: No core source was changed. DeviceUsage is outside the current FHIR-core build, and the external OO Incubator artifact already supports referenced indications through DeviceUsage.reason.
